articles.summary: Newfront SVP Adam Gregorius recently hosted a gathering of influential People leaders to discuss the intersection of AI and Human Resources. The group agreed that HR leaders have a unique opportunity to orchestrate the integration of AI.
articles.title: HR’s Role in Orchestrating a Successful AI Adoption

articles.summary: At the Ai4 2025 Conference in Las Vegas, Lin Yuan, Chief AI Officer and EVP of Engineering at Newfront Insurance, explored how artificial intelligence is redefining the business insurance landscape.
articles.title: Beyond Automation: AI's Strategic Role in Transforming Business Insurance
